title: Cross-machine cooperative claims
goal: Serialize competing task/resource ownership through normal Git pushes
acceptance: Real competing pushes produce one owner
Stale tokens, expiry-only takeover and uncertain replies reconcile without disabling the archive guard
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures only; no external model inference or downstream adoption
validation: Owned task/claim fixtures and template/rule checks
escalation: Stop on missing ownership/evidence or governing-rule conflict
